rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mention type
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The reified implicit or explicit characteristic of a mention.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is setting for
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a situation and something that situation is a setting for.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has mentioned entity
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a mention and a mentioned entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has mention type
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The implicit or explicit characterisation of the mention it is describing.

rdf:Description.dc:creator: Matteo Guenci (https://orcid.org/0009-0006-3139-1667)
rdf:Description.dc:title: The Mention Typing Ontology (MiTO)
rdf:Description.dcterms:bibliographicCitation: Matteo Guenci. The Mention Typing Ontology. Revision: 1.1.0. http://purl.org/spar/mito.
rdf:Description.vann:changes: * **v1.1.0**: Added new documentation, including annotation properties (e.g., `bibo:doi`, `schema:codeRepository`, etc.), term properties (e.g., `vann:example`, `vs:term_status`, etc.), exemplary competency questions with their respective SPARQL queries, and a Grafoo diagram. Added new named individuals `mito:explicit` and `mito:implicit` (previously only mentioned in documentation as `mito:ExplicitMention` and `mito:ImplicitMention`). Specified that `mito:Mention` is a subclass of `sit:Situation` and, as a consequence, its properties as subproperties of `sit:isSettingFor`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is mentioned by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between the two sides involved in the act of mentioning, with one entity being mentioned by the other.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: implicit
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A type of mention according to which something is suggested or understood through context rather than named directly within a text.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mentions
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between the two sides involved in the act of mentioning, with one entity mentioning the other.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: situation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A view on a set of entities. It can be seen as a 'relational context', reifying a relation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has mentioning entity
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a mention and a mentioning entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mention
rdf:Description.skos:note: Originally: the action of calling to mind or commemorating something in speech or writing.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The action or an act of referring to, remarking upon, or introducing the name of a person or thing in spoken or written discourse, often incidentally and as not necessarily essential to the discussion.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: explicit
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A type of mention according to which there is a direct, unambiguous, and literal naming or stating of something within a text.
